title: Junta polynomial sample count
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let the failure parameter be rational and lie in $(0,1/2]$. Let $d$ be the number of coordinates outside $P$, let $r=k-\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$, and let $\delta$ be one quarter of the failure parameter. The sample count is $2^r$ times the sum of the number of subsets of a $d$-element set of size at most $r$ and the least integer $m$ such that $2^m\geq\lceil 2/\delta\rceil$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$
